1. Scope — Covers requirements of full size leg guards used by hockey goal keepers.

2.1 The sewing thread used for general sewing shall conform to variety No. 28 of IS : 1720-1978 
'Specification for cotton sewing threads {second revision)' . The sewing thread for straps sewing 
shall conform to variety No. 11 of 15:1376-1979 'Specification for cotton sewing thread for aero- 
space purposes (second revision)'. 

2.1.1 The sewing thread of poiyamide/cotton corespun having following requirements shall be 
used: 

Nominal count and construction — Nm 50/4 'Z' (finishing twist) 

Finish — Glace 

Single thread breaking load, Min — 53 N (5'4 kg?)

FIG. 1 LEG GUARD, HOCKEY GOAL KEEPER 

4. Weight — 2*8 to 30 kg per pair. 

5. Other Requirements — Leg guards shall be flexible when tied round the leg and shall not in any 
way impair the player. The leather straps shall be 14 to 15 mm wide and 2 to 2*5 mm thick and of 
sufficient length to go round the part of the leg where these are fitted. The central ribs shall end at a 
distance of 50 to 60 mm from the arch of the instep. On the sides, the ribs shall 30 right up to the 
end of the ankle so as to provide adequate protection to the ankle. In addition, the ankle portion 
may be given double layer of canvas or leather. The arch of the instep shall be properly padded. 
Cardboard packing cut to size of the ribs, shall be used between the ribs and the stuffing for better 
results. The straps shall be hand stitched. Machine stitching may be used for other stitchings. The 
number of stitches in both the cases shall be between 3 and 4 per centimetre. 

2 ■ 



IS .10771 - 1983 

5.1 Leg Guards for Hockey Goal Keepers — Each leg guard shall have nine ribs in the main body, 
nine in the top and two on the sides. It shall have a fixed strap for the top, knee and ankle and one 
movable strap for the boot and two for the calf. It shali have a minimum of two sponge rubber pads 
in the main body and one at the knee joint, It shall also be reinforced with an extra canvas or leather 
piece below the boot and ankle portion. 

6. Marking — Each leg guard shall be legibly and indelibly marked on the inside with the manufac- 
turer's name, initials or trade-mark. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with Indian Standards Institution. 

7. Packing — Leg guards shall be kept in pairs and packed in accordance with the existing trade 
practice or according to instructions of the purchaser. 

8. Sampling — Sampling and criteria for acceptance for leg guards shall be as agreed to between 
the purchaser and the supplier. A recommended scheme for the same is given in Appendix A. 



APPENDIX A 

( Clause 8 ) 

RECOMMENDED SAMPLING SCHEME AND CRITERIA FOR 
CONFORMITY FOR LEG GUARDS 

A-1 . Lot — In any consignment, all the pairs of leg guards of the same type and manufactured from 
the same raw materials shall be grouped together to constitute a lot. 

A-2. Selection of Sample — The number of pairs of leg guards to be selected at random for 
inspection from each lot shall be in accordance with col 1 and 2 of Table 2. 

A-3. Number of Tests and Criteria for Conformity — Each pair of leg guards selected in accor- 
dance with A-2 and Table 2 shall be inspected for all the requirements of the type of leg-guard. 
A pair shall be considered as defective if it fails to satisfy any one or more of the requirements of the 
specification. The lot shali be declared as conforming to the requirements of this specification if the 
number of defective pairs in the sample does not exceed the corresponding permissible number of 
defective pairs given in col 3 of Table 2.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The requirements of leg guards for hockey goal keepers were earlier covered in IS : 3923-1966 
which are now being covered in this standard. IS: 3923-1966 has been revised and published as 
IS : 3923-1983 'Specification for leg guards for cricket batsmen and wicket keepers (first revision)' 
covering the requirements of leg guards for cricket batsmen and wicket keepers only.
